Floriso Trail
Puiet
Pelulu
Zianga
Anono
Radi
Puiet the Spirit Tree
Cannot go to another map during the battle!
BOSS BATTLE\nCalm Puiet down!!
Aye, have we arrived?
Is this the place where the Spirit Tree is?\nI mean, wow~.
I know right...It's not the kind of thing I'd say\nusually, but this is a beautiful place.
That's because Puiet is here. The Spirit Tree's\nspecial power helps the plants around here grow.
Hmm, maybe it's like a tree fairy~.
There's nothing suspicious about it.\nDon't you know? The Eumanos turn into huge trees\nwhen they get old if they stay healthy.
You've heard of the Eumanos' special warriors,\n"the Sproutlings", right? Puiet is an "Elderroot",\nwhich is a higher rank than the Sproutlings.
Even after turning into a tree, he continues to\nexert his mysterious power.
Hmm, you really know a lot about the Eumanos.
Actually I'm a botanist...I've been studying it\nfor almost 50 years, I guess. I started back when\nCoenubia wasn't this violent.
Oh my gosh?! 50 years?! I thought you were\nyoung~!
Weredragons can live up to 500 years.\nEven if he's 50 now, he's still considered young,\nyou know?
But it's rare for a weredragon to be a scholar.\nWell, I could tell you weren't a warrior from that\nawkward stance when you held your weapon earlier.
Tch, that boorish behavior is exactly why I can\nnever like weredragons.
It seems that Puiet's power isn't perfect, is it~?\nI can still see some wastelands and traces of\nCoenubia's contamination here and there.
Coenubia has invaded this place too. Like I said,\nPuiet is an "Elderroot". There was no way he would\nlose to Coenubia, but...
Aye, is he injured?
My gosh? So this is Puiet?\nHe's way bigger than I expected!
Once a Eumano turns into a tree, their lifespan\nis tremendously extended and they just keep\ngetting bigger and bigger.
He's not responding at all. Is he okay?
He's just sleeping. Once they turn into a tree,\ntheir sleep cycle changes. Sometimes they sleep\nfor days, and sometimes they don't sleep at all...
Hmm~...
Hey, don't do that! You can't touch Puiet!
U-ugh...
Remember I told you that Coenubia invaded this\nplace? Puiet was injured, and the contamination\nfrom Coenubia spread from his wounds.
He has lost his memory and he's not in his right\nmind now! He'll attack anyone who comes near him!
My gosh!\nWhat the hey?! Why are you only telling me this\nnow?!
Grrrroooaarrh!!
No way?! A moving giant tree?!
Puiet is an "Elderroot"! He's special, you know!
Listen! Try to drain his stamina slowly! But don't\nhit him too hard! If anything happens to my fa...\nto Puiet, I won't forgive you!
Seriously? What kind of nonsense is that?!
Uh, ugh...
Puiet?!
Uhm, he seems to have fallen asleep...
Hey, if he's dangerous, you should have told us\nsooner!
Oh, sorry. You're right, I should have told you.
Radi, I think I know what you want us to do.\nYou want us to heal Puiet's wounds and\ndecontaminate this place right?
Wow, you're smarter than I thought.\nThat's right. Puiet is special to me, and I'll do\nwhatever I can to help him.
Aye, Radi really loves Puiet!
But don't you think it's a weird combo~?\nA weredragon scholar and an old Eumano tree.\nThere's gotta be a reason for it, right?
As I said before, I'm a botanist. I've been\ntraveling around the world of Toram to broaden my\nhorizons for almost 40 years now, I guess...
At some point, I heard rumors about Puiet, and\nI really felt I had to meet him.
After researching for quite some time, I found\nthat hidden cave...and it allowed the Coenubias to\nget in.
That's when Puiet got hurt, right?
Yeah, I was badly injured too. I almost died,\nbut Puiet didn't abandon me...
Even though I was a total stranger and the one\nresponsible for the whole mess. He even hurt\nhimself just to give me water and keep me alive.
With the contamination worsening here, it's become\ndifficult for him to even talk. I've decided to\ndedicate the rest of my life to Puiet.
Got it. Either way, if we wanna know how to get\npast this mountain, we'll need to decontaminate\nthis place and bring back his memory.
Yeah, we've got no choice but to help here~!
Right?
Thanks!\nI knew you were great people from the moment I met\nyou. My gut feeling turned out to be right!
You really know how to flatter people~!\nSo, what do we need to find?
Uh, we need "Stagnant Fertilizer" to clean up\nthe contamination in Puiet's body. Please go find\nsome.
I think you can find them in the cave or along\nthe trail to the foothills.
Got it! Alright, let's go!
Aye!
We've just met and I've already asked you such a\ntroublesome favor. I'm sorry. I wish I could find\nthem myself...
It's okay.\nWe know it's a bit too much for a clumsy guy like\nyou.
You're being mean again.\nI just can't bring myself to like weredragons.
U-ugh...
Hey!! How many times do I need to tell you?!\nYou can't wake him up!! What if he goes berserk\nagain?!
Radi~! We found the Stagnant Fertilizer you need~!\nFinding it wasn't easy, though~!
Aye? Radi isn't here?
Where could he have gone?
This water isn't contaminated, but you're not\nabsorbing it at all...Puiet, don't tell me\nyou're...
Oh!! There you are!!\nWe've got the Stagnant Fertilizer you need~!!
Oh, you're back...
This is enough! Thanks for collecting it!
So we can decontaminate Puiet with this?
I've been working solely on this research for\nalmost a year. It should work...But then again,\nI'm still not a fully qualified botanist.
Now you're starting to worry about it, huh?
Hahaha, it's okay! Well, just watch!
O-oh, Radi...\nI'm myself again now. My memory is back...
Puiet!!
Oh my gosh!! You did it!!
Aye! You cleansed him!
Hahaha, you did it, Radi!
I'm aware that you've helped me.\nMy name is Puiet, some call me "the Spirit Tree",\na rather pompous moniker, I'd say.
You know what happened?\nI guess your memory is still intact, huh?
I just couldn't speak or move. But I still\nremember everything I saw and heard clearly.
I saw you taking care of me every single day,\nRadi. Thank you.
That was nothing compared to what you did for me,\nPuiet.
Alright, lemme get straight to the point then.\nThere's something we'd like to ask you.
Do you know how to get past this mountain? This\nRode Zaag Range?
My roots have grown long enough to reach every\ncorner of this mountain, so don't worry...
After I disappear, the traces of my roots will\nbecome a tunnel that allows you to reach the other\nside of the mountain.
Wow! Nice!\nBut hold on, after Puiet disappears, the traces of\nhis roots will become a tunnel...?!
After you disappear...what do you mean?
Aye? Puiet, are you going to disappear?
Puiet...had the contamination already caused\nirreversible damage to you?
Yeah, the Stagnant Fertilizer only cleared the\nsurface...The contamination has already spread to\nthe core of my trunk and tips of my roots.
So I wouldn't be surprised if I wither away now...
Oh, come on, don't say that!\nYou finally got your memory back. There's gotta be\nsomething we can do to fix this, right?!
Yeah, she's right!\nIf there's anything else you need, just tell us!
Puiet...you just smiled to pretend you're okay,\nright? You're actually in pain, aren't you?\nIs it really painful?
I'm glad that at least I could regain my memory\nand talk with you one last time, Radi...\nPlease take this...and let it grow somewhere...
This is...
It's a sapling from my tree.
Even if I wither away, as long as this sapling\ncontinues to grow, it's the same thing as me being\nthere...
Hahaha, I guess it's a bit hard for you to\nunderstand...That's because it's something that\nonly makes sense to us...
Okay, Puiet...\nI'll take care of this sapling until I die,\nI promise.
I'm relieved to hear that...\nWell then, thank you for everything you've done\nfor me...Take care, my child...
Okay. Thank you for working so hard all this\ntime...And, I'm sorry, father...
Radi, what's your plan now?
I'm just gonna fulfill my promise to Puiet.\nI'll take a break from my botanist work. I'll go\nhome and grow this sapling into a fine tree.
Yeah, that's prolly a good idea...
Alright, time to say goodbye.\nSorry for all the trouble, and thank you.
Aye! Take care, Radi!
Is that sapling really just a sapling, though~?
What do you mean?
It's all for Radi's sake.
It's to make him leave this place.
Hm, you think so too?
Otherwise, Radi might have tried to stay and\nprotect this place from Coenubia in Puiet's stead,\nsince Puiet used to live here~.
I see. So he told Radi to grow the sapling to keep\nhim away from danger and make him leave this\nplace?!
That's what I thought too~.\nHe just wanted Radi to stay away from this place~.
Makes sense. Radi might try to protect this place\nfrom Coenubia, even though he knows it's\ndangerous, because Puiet used to live here.
Right, it'd be impossible to grow that sapling\nsafely here~.
Welp, that's just my guess, though~.
A young weredragon scholar and a Eumano elder, two\ncompletely different beings...It's amazing that\nthey could grow so close, like father and son.
Aye! It's just like us!
Huh? What do you mean?
Aye! A weredragon, a Lixi, and a weird race...\nWe're all different, but we get along!
Tch, stop saying stuff that makes us feel awkward,\nplease~! This precious tunnel Puiet left us isn't\ngonna last forever, so let's hurry~!
We're all different, but we get along...
